versions.changelog:
- Initial release of tweet-thread-generator.
- Converts technical articles and blogs into engaging Twitter/X threads.
- Automatically adds trending hashtags and optimizes post length.
- Supports multiple languages and intelligent thread segmentation.
- Offers preset and customizable opening lines for enhanced engagement.
- Provides easy CLI usage for text, files, and URLs, plus interactive mode.
- Includes configuration options for topic, tone, format, and language.
